title: Choosing among SAR images for the Gran Sasso scan

tellings.quote: I had to to to to let's say order um different images in order to choose the best one.

plain: Sometime in the 2020s, the researcher Filippo Biondi says he had to sort through several SAR images, radar pictures taken from satellites, to pick the best one for scanning beneath Gran Sasso, a mountain in Italy. He tells Michels he did this himself, as part of testing the radar method he uses to look for structures underground, including beneath the pyramids of Egypt.
